search_text: published ZDI-20-1097 ZDI-CAN-10601 (0Day) Hewlett Packard Enterprise Pay per use UCS Meter ReceiverServlet doPost Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-09-08 CVE-2020-24626 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-24626 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Hewlett Packard Enterprise'] ['Pay per use UCS Meter'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Pay per use UCS Meter. title: (0Day) Hewlett Packard Enterprise Pay per use UCS Meter ReceiverServlet doPost Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Pay per use UCS Meter. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ReceiverServlet class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
